Role & responsibilities

Role Purpose

Own and deliver endtoend GenAI and agentic AI modules, driving design decisions, best practices, and mentoring JL4 engineers.

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement productiongrade GenAI architectures
Own AWS Bedrock integrations (models, KBs, guardrails, cost controls)
Build agentic systems with planning, memory, retries, and state
Lead LangGraph workflows (conditional routing, interrupts, HITL)
Define evaluation, observability, and cost optimisation strategies
Drive CI/CD, Docker, IaC, and security practices
Mentor juniors and participate in design reviews

MustHave Skills

Advanced Python - Async patterns, multiprocessing, Profiling, performance tuning, Clean project structuring & testing strategy

AWS Bedrock - Model selection & access policies, Streaming, tool-use, guardrails, Knowledge base design & scaling,

GenAI / Agentic AI - Task decomposition, long-running workflows, Multi-agent patterns, Evaluation, grounding, hallucination control, Cost, latency, success KPIs. LangChain & LangGraph nodes, edges, interrupts, LCEL, agents, evaluators, Persistence, resumes, HITL

DevOps & Platform Docker multi-stage builds,CI/CD ownership, Terraform, secrets , management, SAST/DAST awareness

Good to Have

Production RAG optimization experience, Responsible AI / Guardrails exposure, Drift detection & monitoring, Strong articulation & stakeholder interaction, Ownership mindset, Mentoring & technical leadership




Preferred candidate profile
